title: GMC Sierra 1500 Engines by Year (1988–2026)
description: Every factory engine in the GMC Sierra 1500 by year, 1988–2026: the 4.3 V6, small block, Vortec and EcoTec3 V8s, diesels, the 2.7 turbo and the Sierra EV.
intro: GMC's half-ton pickup took the Sierra name with the 1988 redesign. When a new generation arrived, the previous truck stayed on sale for a time as the Sierra Classic or Sierra Limited; the trims column marks those years.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.

generations.name: GMT400
intro: The 4.3 V6, the 5.0 and 5.7 V8s, the 6.2 diesel and, from 1994, the 6.5 diesel; Vortec engines from 1996.

generations.name: GMT800
intro: The 4.3 V6, the 4.8, 5.3 and 6.0 Vortec V8s, the Denali's 6.0, and a hybrid from 2004.

generations.name: GMT900
intro: The 4.3 V6, the 4.8, 5.3 and 6.2 V8s, and the two-mode hybrid.

generations.name: K2XX
intro: The 4.3 V6 and the 5.3 and 6.2 EcoTec3 V8s, with eAssist from 2016.

generations.name: T1
intro: The 2.7 turbo four, the 5.3 and 6.2 V8s, the 3.0 Duramax diesel and, from 2024, the electric Sierra EV.
